recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-12157 unless a work group separately decides to reword the broader CDA mapping narrative.
issue_request: FHIR-12157 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Structured Documents issue raised for DSTU2. It asked to remove the confusing term "logical" from the Composition.identifier description, change the description to "A version-independent identifier for the Composition.", add a Composition.identifier comment saying it is similar to ClinicalDocument/setId in CDA, and review the Composition.identifier definitions page.
initial_application: The Jira comments record SVN revision 13099. In the imported git history, commit c32045aa03c53ca221429952838c61a7c3a16616 is that git-svn revision and changed the Composition spreadsheet from "Logical identifier of composition (version-independent)" and "Logical identifier for the composition" to the version-independent wording, while adding the ClinicalDocument/setId comment. The later generated StructureDefinition source retained that applied wording through the source rework commits.
additional_context: Composition is active in source/fhir.ini and source/composition/structuredefinition-Composition.xml is the authoritative current source. FHIR-5493 is earlier background for the CDA mapping discussion, FHIR-32532 later changed Composition.identifier cardinality to 0..* without altering the FHIR-12157 wording, and FHIR-30766 later cleaned the CDA Bundle identifier narrative referenced by the Composition.identifier comment. Focused Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting decision for FHIR-12157.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active current source already expresses the requested version-independent identifier description and CDA setId comment. Remaining uses of "logical" in the Composition narrative or Composition.version comment are broader contextual wording, not the confusing Composition.identifier definition that FHIR-12157 changed.
